qualifier: methionine–SAM cycle and its inborn errors
name: Folate one-carbon and methionine–SAM cycle metabolism
rationale: Members span folate/tetrahydrofolate one-carbon metabolism and the methionine–SAM–homocysteine cycle (MAT1A, MTR, MTRR, AHCY defects), distinguishing it from folate-only, choline/carnitine, selenium and cobalamin neighbours.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription and mRNA turnover
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and mRNA turnover
rationale: Members concern mtDNA replication/repair, mitochondrial transcription and mt-mRNA stability/decay, whereas confusables centre on mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA processing and translation.

core: Integrin–fibronectin cell–matrix adhesion and stress fibres
qualifier: Rho GTPase activation of ROCK and PAK
name: Cell–matrix adhesion with Rho–ROCK/PAK stress fibre assembly
rationale: Members link fibronectin/syndecan/integrin matrix adhesion to actin stress fibre assembly, and uniquely include Rho GTPase activation of ROCKs and PAKs, absent from the adhesion/MET/focal-adhesion confusables.

qualifier: eNOS trafficking and activation
name: Endothelial NOS activation and nitric oxide–cGMP signaling
rationale: Members cover eNOS trafficking/activation, NOS regulation and NO–cGMP signal transduction, unlike confusables focused on renal natriuretic cGMP, smooth muscle tone or shear stress.

qualifier: spliceosome and snRNP biogenesis with 3'-end processing
name: Pre-mRNA splicing, snRNP biogenesis and 3'-end processing
rationale: Members span spliceosome assembly and splicing, snRNA transcription/snRNP assembly and mRNA/histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing, lacking the rRNA/Pol I/III and mRNA export content of confusables.

qualifier: regulation of fatty acid entry via carnitine shuttle and malonyl-CoA
name: Control of fatty acid entry into beta-oxidation
rationale: Members regulate fatty acid import, the carnitine shuttle, malonyl-CoA and medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism, whereas confusables hold the individual beta-oxidation steps, ketone bodies or lipid droplet turnover.

qualifier: NFE2L2 regulation and detoxification/stress target genes
name: NFE2L2 regulation and stress-response target genes
rationale: All members are NFE2L2 (NRF2) expression or its antioxidant, detoxification, ER-stress, inflammation and MDR target programs, unlike confusables covering generic ROS responses, NFE2L2 metabolic targets or FOXO.

qualifier: lysophospholipid hydrolysis and choline catabolism
name: Choline and carnitine metabolism with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover choline transport/catabolism (incl. FMO3/TMAU), carnitine and creatine synthesis and LPC/LPE hydrolysis, distinguishing it from acetylcholine/phosphocreatine and SAM-centred neighbours.

qualifier: matrix metalloproteinase-mediated collagen and elastin breakdown
name: Matrix metalloproteinase-mediated collagen and elastin degradation
rationale: All members concern MMP activation and collagen/elastin catabolism and its negative regulation, unlike confusables on ECM synthesis, fibrinolysis or contact activation.

qualifier: ectopic calcification and enamel mineralization disorders
name: Phosphate homeostasis, ectopic calcification and enamel mineralization
rationale: Members concern phosphate transport/homeostasis and PTH response together with mineralization control and its disorders (PXE, IBGC1, amelogenesis imperfecta), unlike SLC34/FGF23-klotho or dentinogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: flipping/scrambling with membrane repair and mechanical stress
name: Membrane phospholipid flipping, scrambling and mechanical stress response
rationale: Members cover aminophospholipid flipping and Ca-activated scrambling alongside membrane repair, blebbing, cell volume and pressure/mechanical load, unlike ER lipid-transfer, apoptotic-cell clearance or apical transport neighbours.

qualifier: regulated protein import/export and ribosomal subunit export
name: Nuclear pore protein and ribosomal subunit transport
rationale: Members concern NPC-mediated protein import/export and its regulation plus ribosomal subunit export, whereas confusables emphasise mRNA/IP export, NPC assembly and SUMOylation.

qualifier: entry, reverse transcription and Vpu/Env synthesis
name: HIV entry, reverse transcription and Vpu–Env synthesis
rationale: Members cover HIV binding, entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and Env/Vpu (CD4 degradation), lacking the integration, Nef and other-virus content of confusables.

qualifier: palmitoylation and prenylation of Wnt, Hedgehog, Ras and Rab
name: Palmitoylation and prenylation of Wnt, Hedgehog, Ras and Rab
rationale: Members cover S-palmitoylation/depalmitoylation, geranylgeranylation and Hh autoprocessing for Wnt, Hedgehog, Ras and Rab proteins, unlike downstream Hh or Wnt signalling confusables.

core: Type II interferon and IL-12 family signaling
name: IFN-gamma, IL-12-family and IL-10 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma signalling and its regulation plus IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-10 signalling, unlike type I/III interferon or IL-2/IL-6 family confusables.

qualifier: cell size control and muscle atrophy
name: Calcineurin–NFAT signaling, cell size and muscle atrophy
rationale: Members concern calcineurin/NFAT calcium signalling with cell size, dendrite morphogenesis and inactivity-induced muscle atrophy, unlike hypertrophy, phosphatase or contraction confusables.

qualifier: renal angiotensin signaling and glomerular filtration
name: Renin–angiotensin renal control of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin signalling and renal control of blood volume, filtration and arterial pressure, unlike aldosterone/sodium or angiotensin metabolism/natriuretic confusables.

qualifier: endogenous peptide loading in the ER
name: MHC class I peptide loading of endogenous antigens
rationale: Members concern cytosol-to-ER peptide transport and assembly/loading of endogenous peptides on MHC class I, unlike proteasome or cross-presentation confusables.

qualifier: CYP oxidation and conjugation of drugs and toxins
name: Xenobiotic and toxin biotransformation by CYP oxidation and conjugation
rationale: Members cover CYP-mediated oxidation (CYP1A2, CYP2E1, demethylation) and sulfonation/methylation/acetylation of drugs, mycotoxins and plant compounds, unlike steroid, FMO or thiopurine confusables.

qualifier: phosphorylation cascade and oncogenic mutants
name: Beta-catenin destruction complex phosphorylation and its oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members are the beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and CTNNB1, APC, AXIN, AMER1 and GSK3B mutants impairing it, unlike Notch or downstream Wnt/TCF confusables.

core: Integrated stress response and unfolded protein response
qualifier: eIF2-alpha kinases (GCN2, HRI, PERK) and IRE1–XBP1
name: Integrated stress response via eIF2-alpha kinases and PERK/IRE1 UPR
rationale: Members cover stress-induced translational control via GCN2, HRI and PERK, ATF4 and IRE1–XBP1 UPR and mitochondrial stress, whereas confusables are ATF6/CREB3-driven.

qualifier: integrin-mediated cell–cell adhesion and migration
name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte cell–cell adhesion and migration
rationale: Members concern integrin activation, integrin- and PECAM1-mediated heterotypic adhesion and leukocyte migration, unlike synapse-formation, Rap1-signalling or extravasation confusables.

qualifier: clostridial neurotoxin action
name: Cholinergic neuromuscular transmission and clostridial neurotoxin action
rationale: Members cover acetylcholine synthesis, choline uptake (SLC5A7), release, nicotinic receptors and botulinum/tetanus toxin action, unlike GABA/glutamate/glycine or NMJ-assembly confusables.

qualifier: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 via STAT5
name: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are EPO, TPO, IL-3, IL-5, G-CSF and FLT3 (incl. fusion) signalling via STAT5, PI3K and RAS, unlike PDGFR, common-gamma-chain or FLT3-inhibitor-resistance confusables.

qualifier: leukotriene B4 inactivation
name: Leukotriene and eicosanoid catabolism
rationale: All three members concern catabolism of leukotrienes (LTB4) and icosanoids, whereas confusables cover leukotriene/lipoxin/HETE synthesis and signalling.
